title: The furniture a level is fitted with
summary: A level in R.E.P.O. is furnished as well as built: the build names chairs, tables, lamps and a television of its own, and even the fish in a room is filed as a valuable.
body: Rooms in R.E.P.O. are furnished rather than left bare. The build names chairs of its own, an armchair and a plain and a big version among them, so a room reads as a place someone used rather than as a box with loot in it.

Tables are named by room as well as by size. There are arctic tables of more than one size, which is why the same level can hold a big table in one room and a small one in the next without either looking out of place.

The lighting is part of the set. The build names lamps for the rooms, including a small arctic ceiling lamp, and it even carries two spellings of the same piece, which is the kind of thing this project does not tidy up on the game's behalf.
A room can hold a screen. There is a flat-screen television of its own, named both with and without a space, so a furnished room is not only tables and chairs.
Furniture is scenery you can still break. The pieces carry their own reactions, which is why a chair can be thrown across a room and come apart rather than passing through everything.

Not everything on a table is decoration. The build files fish as a valuable of its own, with a mesh and a material beside it and a museum version for the museum, so what looks like room dressing can be worth carrying out.
That is why furniture matters beyond how a room looks: it tells you which theme you are standing in, it gives you something to hide behind, and it can be the thing the run is scored on.
What this entry does not tell you: what any piece of furniture is worth, how much damage it takes, or which rooms hold which pieces. We have not verified those, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Chairs are named in kinds: an armchair, a plain chair, a big chair and a camp chair among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Armchair, Chair, Chair Big, Camp Chair

facts.claim: Tables are named by room and by size, including an arctic round table and a small arctic one.
facts.evidence: asset names: Arctic Round Table, Arctic Small Table

facts.claim: Lamps are named for the rooms as well, a small arctic ceiling lamp among them, and the build even carries two spellings of that piece.
facts.evidence: asset names: Arctic Ceiling Lamp Small, Arctic Celing Lamp Small

facts.claim: A furnished room can hold a television of its own, named both with and without a space.
facts.evidence: asset names: Flat screen TV, FlatScreenTV

facts.claim: Fish are filed as a valuable of their own, with a mesh and a material beside them and a museum version.
facts.evidence: asset names: Fish valuable, Valuable Fish, Valuable Museum Fish, FishMesh, FishMaterial
